name: camayoc_open_plans
description: Open/in-progress Plan, Design and Directive tracker projections with a unique current snapshot, owner and recorded about links. Groups normalized UTC-Z timestamps at read time; malformed/undated/conflicting observations do not yield a current row. Topic is a case-insensitive snapshot substring, not semantic inference. At most100 rows; not an exhaustive absence check.
template: PREFIX a: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?kind ?status ?owner ?ownerState ?observedAt ?about ?snapshot FROM <{records}> WHERE { { SELECT ?item (MAX(?candidateKey) AS ?latestKey) WHERE { ?item a:workKind ?kind ; a:observes ?candidate . FILTER(?kind = "Plan" || ?kind = "Design" || ?kind = "Directive") ?candidate a:observedAt ?candidateAt . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?candidateAt), "^(([0-9][0-9](0[48]|[2468][048]|[13579][26])|(0[48]|[2468][048]|[13579][26])00)-02-29|([0-9][0-9][0-9][1-9]|[0-9][0-9][1-9][0-9]|[0-9][1-9][0-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9])-((0[13578]|1[02])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])|(0[469]|11)-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)|02-(0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-8])))T([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9](\\.[0-9][0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?)?Z$")) BIND(CONCAT("t", SUBSTR(STR(?candidateAt),1,19), ".", SUBSTR(CONCAT(IF(CONTAINS(STR(?candidateAt),"."), STRBEFORE(STRAFTER(STR(?candidateAt),"."),"Z"), ""), "000000000"),1,9)) AS ?candidateKey) } GROUP BY ?item } ?item a:workKind ?kind ; a:observes ?obs . ?obs a:observedAt ?rawAt ; a:observedStatus ?status ; a:observedValue ?rawSnapshot . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?rawAt), "^(([0-9][0-9](0[48]|[2468][048]|[13579][26])|(0[48]|[2468][048]|[13579][26])00)-02-29|([0-9][0-9][0-9][1-9]|[0-9][0-9][1-9][0-9]|[0-9][1-9][0-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9])-((0[13578]|1[02])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])|(0[469]|11)-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)|02-(0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-8])))T([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9](\\.[0-9][0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?)?Z$")) BIND(CONCAT("t", SUBSTR(STR(?rawAt),1,19), ".", SUBSTR(CONCAT(IF(CONTAINS(STR(?rawAt),"."), STRBEFORE(STRAFTER(STR(?rawAt),"."),"Z"), ""), "000000000"),1,9)) AS ?timeKey) FILTER(?timeKey = ?latestKey) BIND(REPLACE(STR(?rawSnapshot), ",\"kind\":\"(Plan|Design|Directive|DreamCycle)\"", "") AS ?snapshot) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item a:observes ?bad . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?bad a:observedAt ?dated } } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item a:observes ?bad . ?bad a:observedAt ?badAt . FILTER(!REGEX(STR(?badAt), "^(([0-9][0-9](0[48]|[2468][048]|[13579][26])|(0[48]|[2468][048]|[13579][26])00)-02-29|([0-9][0-9][0-9][1-9]|[0-9][0-9][1-9][0-9]|[0-9][1-9][0-9][0-9]|[1-9][0-9][0-9][0-9])-((0[13578]|1[02])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])|(0[469]|11)-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|30)|02-(0[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-8])))T([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9](\\.[0-9][0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?[0-9]?)?Z$")) } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item a:observes ?peer . ?peer a:observedAt ?peerAt ; a:observedValue ?peerValue . BIND(CONCAT("t", SUBSTR(STR(?peerAt),1,19), ".", SUBSTR(CONCAT(IF(CONTAINS(STR(?peerAt),"."), STRBEFORE(STRAFTER(STR(?peerAt),"."),"Z"), ""), "000000000"),1,9)) AS ?peerKey) FILTER(?peerKey = ?latestKey) BIND(REPLACE(STR(?peerValue), ",\"kind\":\"(Plan|Design|Directive|DreamCycle)\"", "") AS ?peerSnapshot) FILTER(?peerSnapshot != ?snapshot) } FILTER(?status = "open" || ?status = "in_progress") OPTIONAL { ?item a:about ?about } BIND(IF(REGEX(STR(?snapshot), "\"assignee\":\"([^\"\\\\]*)\""), REPLACE(STR(?snapshot), "^.*\"assignee\":\"([^\"\\\\]*)\".*$", "$1"), "") AS ?owner) BIND(IF(CONTAINS(STR(?snapshot), '"assignee":null') || CONTAINS(STR(?snapshot), '"assignee":""'), "unassigned", IF(REGEX(STR(?snapshot), "\"assignee\":\"([^\"\\\\]*)\""), "assigned", "unknown")) AS ?ownerState) BIND(CONCAT(SUBSTR(?latestKey,2),"Z") AS ?observedAt) FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?snapshot)), LCASE("{topic}"))) } ORDER BY DESC(?latestKey) ?item ?about LIMIT 100

params.name: records
params.description: Tracker projection plane. Only UTC-Z observedAt timestamps up to9 fractional digits are supported.

params.name: topic
params.description: Case-insensitive snapshot substring; empty lists all planned kinds.
